verdict.rationale: Navan is a travel and expense SaaS with a developer platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence documents only a hosted MCP server, a REST API and an llms.txt file. The one command-line snippet (`claude mcp add ...`) uses Claude's CLI to register Navan's MCP server, so it is a third-party client tool, not a Navan CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
